xBRIEFInfo.description: Scope xBRIEF: gates-surface readiness doctor + skill dual invoke

plan.title: bug(doctor/skills): gates-surface broken for consumers — dual deft/task invoke

narratives.Description: Directive skills teach bare task pr:watch and review-monitor gates that many consumers cannot invoke, breaking deep-think harness performance. This story elevates doctor Taskfile-include messaging for gates readiness and aligns always-pin skills to probe deft then task deft: then #2878 fallback.
narratives.Overview: Major consumer harness bugfix MVP; policy enforce and init banner deferred.
narratives.UserStory: As a consumer agent running review-cycle, I want doctor and skills to surface working gate invoke paths (deft or task deft:), so that missing bare task verbs do not force freestyle poll loops.
narratives.ImplementationPlan: Step 1: Update packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts runTaskfileIncludeCheck copy and elevate warning when resolution is proceed/clean with dual remediations (deft verbs + include snippet); adjust taskfile.ts messaging as needed. Step 2: Update content/skills/deft-directive-review-cycle/SKILL.md and content/skills/deft-directive-swarm/SKILL.md probe order: deft/directive CLI first, then task deft:verb, then #2878 fallback; stop bare task pr:watch as sole consumer form. Step 3: Unit tests for doctor messaging/findings and skill content-contract markers. Step 4: Docs touch openclaw-agent-host or consumer docs if needed; CHANGELOG cites #2893. Verification: run doctor unit tests and skill contract tests; task check:merge before push.
narratives.Labels: bug, adoption-blocker, doctor, tooling, agent-experience, area:skills, harness
narratives.Traces: Acceptance maps to #2893 AC; missing_traces_justification until line maps.

items.title: Doctor elevates missing Taskfile include when otherwise clean

narrative.Acceptance: Given consumer deposit and resolution proceed without higher-severity findings, when classifyTaskfileInclude is not ok, then doctor emits warning naming deep-think gates with dual remediations (deft + include snippet).

items.title: Doctor copy frames gates readiness not optional-only task surface

narrative.Acceptance: Given doctor taskfile-include messaging, when read, then purpose is gates readiness and it does not claim include is only for optional task deft:X convenience.

items.title: Review-cycle and swarm probe order deft then task deft: then fallback

narrative.Acceptance: Given review-cycle and swarm skill text, when agent follows probe guidance, then deft/directive CLI is first, task deft: second when include present, #2878 fallback last; bare task pr:watch is not sole consumer form.
Given the PR, when tests run, then doctor gates-surface cases and skill contract markers pass and CHANGELOG Unreleased cites #2893.
